title: P4 execution conventions, amended release gate, compatibility comparator, release gating and evidence procedures

sections.title: Rules every P4 item follows
sections.text:
P4 qualifies the candidate and freezes it; it does not redesign anything (D4, D12: "only changes demonstrated necessary by qualification").

1. **Demonstrated fixes only.** Production code (`packages/**`) changes only for a failure that a qualification check demonstrates: a failing test or CI job, a consumer or relocation run, the compatibility drill, or a bench correctness check / engine error. Each fix is minimal, has a test that fails without it, lands in its own commit and gets one row in `plans/2026.10.10-№1-AZGUARD-CORE-STABILIZATION/artifacts/evidence/P4/fixes.md`: `id | failing check (command or CI job URL + log line) | root cause | file:line | fix commit`.
2. **Stop rule for frozen contracts.** A fix that would change a supported type or member signature, a parameter name or default, a named-argument stance, an enum case or its closed/open class, a config key/default/environment name, a command/option/exit code, a publish tag, a migration basename, an event type or payload key, a doctor check key/finding id, the explain JSON or an exception code is not a qualification fix: stop, `plan.py log <plan> <item> --type friction` with the evidence, and ask the owner (naming and API shape are not reopened, knowledge/architecture#api-compatibility "One transition").
3. **1.0 is the starting point (D24, D25, owner M17).** No code, test, fixture, CI file or doc mentions a 0.x version, except the root `UPGRADING.md` (the AI-agent instruction kept by D25) and the two tests that must name what they check (`tests/Arch/LegacyNamesTest.php`, `tests/Arch/MigrationGuideTest.php`). The git tags `v0.3.0` and `v0.7.0` stay (owner territory) and every tool ignores them: stable-tag resolution requires major ≥ 1.
4. **Reference wins, no shims (D16).** knowledge/contracts, knowledge/identities as amended by knowledge/p3-execution#amendments and pinned by the current fixtures, and knowledge/type-map stay authoritative. No `class_alias`, forwarding class or deprecated member.
5. **Snapshots.** A deliberate format change (only through the stop rule) regenerates the fixture in writer mode in the same commit (`AZGUARD_FORMATS_WRITE=1 vendor/bin/pest tests/Regression/Formats tests/Feature/Console/CommandsSnapshotTest.php tests/Feature/Configuration/ConfigKeysTest.php`) and lists the fixture in the item result. After any change of a supported type run `composer api:manifest` and commit both manifests.
6. **Owner WIP.** The main checkout carries the owner's uncommitted test-refactor edits: `.github/workflows/tests-nightly.yml`, `bin/test-db.php`, `phpstan.neon`, `tests/Feature/Authorization/Batch/DecideManyParityTest.php`, `tests/Feature/Gate/GateParityTest.php`, `tests/Feature/Visibility/ParityPropertyTest.php`, `tests/Fixtures/Authorization/ScenarioGenerator.php`, `tests/README.md` and the deletion of `tests/Fixtures/Testing/KitCase.php` (check `git status` at item start; the set may have changed). Never stage, revert, stash or overwrite them without asking; commit with `plan.py commit … --path` limited to the item's own files. An item that has to edit one of these files (P4.5 edits `tests-nightly.yml`) first asks the owner to commit or park their change. With that WIP present `composer analyse` reports `trait.unused` for `InteractsWithAzGuard`; record it and ask the owner how to produce the analyse evidence (earlier sessions restored KitCase from HEAD with the owner's approval).
7. **Pushes and the release act (D27).** Never push `main` and never create or push a tag in this repository. GitHub Actions evidence needs the HEAD on the origin branch `feat/1.0-candidate` (the `feat/**` pattern triggers Tests, Static Analysis, Code Style, Zizmor, CodeQL and, from P4.5, Compatibility); that push is the owner gate `CI-PUSH` of P4.2 and P4.8: ask once per item and record the answer with `plan.py grant`. Tagging `v1.0.0`, pushing tags, enabling the split and Packagist stay with the owner after the plan. The drill creates tags only in a throwaway clone.
8. **Long runs.** Full suite, database lanes, engines, replica, Redis, extended, bench, consumer and relocation runs are `impact` checks except in P4.2, P4.6 and P4.8 where they are the acceptance. Start them detached: `setsid nohup <cmd> < /dev/null > <log> 2>&1 &`; run the MySQL and MariaDB `--parallel` lanes alone (they were SIGTERMed when overlapping other runs). Diagnostics (single-test reruns) are never acceptance evidence.
9. **Evidence.** Everything P4 records lives in `plans/2026.10.10-№1-AZGUARD-CORE-STABILIZATION/artifacts/evidence/P4/`: `qualification.md`, `ci-runs.json` (+ `ci-runs-<sha>.json` per pushed commit), `fixes.md`, `drill.md`, `relocation.md`, `race.md`, `load.md`, `gate.md`. Each run row names the HEAD sha, the command, the exit code, counts/duration and the log path (logs under `plans/2026.10.10-№1-AZGUARD-CORE-STABILIZATION/artifacts/evidence/P4/logs/`).
10. **Runtime.** Every PHP check runs with PHP 8.4 (`#commands`), except the explicit PHP 8.3 suite run, which uses `/usr/bin/php8.3`.

sections.title: Release gate for 1.0 as amended by D24: conditions, evidence, items
sections.text:
Release gate of knowledge/architecture#release-gate **as amended by D24** (owner M17: 1.0 is the starting point, no 0.x scenario). The amended rows replace conditions 5, 8 and 10 and the I22 wording of that section; the rest is unchanged. `gate.md` (P4.8) has one row per condition: condition, evidence (paths, CI run URLs, sha), verdict.

| # | Condition (amended) | Evidence on the candidate commit | Item |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | Small core demonstrated: core-only boot/check/write resolves no module service, runs no module query, needs no module table; DevTools console-only; Filament absent from core requirements | `tests/Feature/Activation`, `tests/Feature/InactiveCost` (I13), `bash bin/consumer-fixture.sh core-only`, `packages/core/composer.json` requires | P4.2, P4.8 |
| 2 | Boundaries complete: no core→module, module↔module, module↔Filament reference; one owner per production file; empty allowlists | `tests/Arch` (I2, I3, I5, TargetPlacementTest) | P4.2, P4.8 |
| 3 | Supported surface closed | `composer api:check`, `tests/Arch/ApiManifestTest.php` (I4), `tests/Arch/SpiPositionalCallsTest.php` (I20) | P4.2, P4.8 |
| 4 | Extension semantics proved | `tests/Contracts`, `tests/Modules/*/Contracts`, PipesTest, FinalValidationTest, NegativeFixturesTest, direct-write guards (I6, I8, I10) | P4.2, P4.8 |
| 5 | **Persistence frozen (amended):** DDL, constraints, collations and host keys match the fixtures on SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL and MariaDB for core-only and core+Audit; every fresh-install scenario of knowledge/p3-execution#persistence passes on every driver; shipped basenames fixed | `tests/Fixtures/Storage/ddl/*.json` via StorageDdlTest/StorageSchemaTest (I15), `tests/Feature/Storage/FreshInstallTest.php` (I16) in the three DB lanes | P4.2, P4.8 |
| 6 | Behavior conserved | ParityMatrixTest (I9), NoScopeDeclarationTest (I7) | P4.2, P4.8 |
| 7 | **Consistency conserved (amended):** snapshot/race, dirty-read rejection, nested rollback, retry, after-commit/cache and handle-release suites pass on every driver, replica and Redis; the candidate's load and query profile is recorded as the 1.0 reference with every correctness check passing and zero engine errors (no earlier-version comparison) | engines ×3, `composer test:replica`, `composer test:redis`, `composer test:extended`, `--parallel --full` lanes (I11, I12, I21); `bench/results/<date>-1.0-*` + `load.md` (I22) | P4.6 |
| 8 | **Non-PHP contracts frozen (amended):** config keys/defaults, environment names, identities, event payloads and journal rows, exception codes, commands/options/exit codes, publish tags, doctor/explain JSON and HTTP mapping have fixtures and documentation | `tests/Fixtures/Formats`, CommandsSnapshotTest, ConfigKeysTest (I17); `tests/Arch/FormatsDocumentedTest.php` over `docs/reference` | P4.7 |
| 9 | Distribution qualified: PHP 8.3–8.5 × Laravel 11–13 × lowest/stable, DB lanes, replica, Redis, coverage ≥ 85, phpstan, type coverage ≥ 98, pint, rector, docs gates and build, nightly; core, core+Filament, core-only archives and the relocation rehearsal in clean apps; a tag release cannot bypass them | GitHub Actions on the candidate (`ci-runs-<sha>.json`), `tests/Arch/ReleaseWorkflowTest.php` | P4.2, P4.5, P4.8 |
| 10 | **Freeze operational (amended):** the candidate is the compatibility baseline; CI compares every push/PR (and every release tag) with it, later with the previous stable tag; the drill proves rejection of intentional breaks; a PR cannot replace the baseline without the explicit `compat-baseline` label; the AI-agent instruction in `UPGRADING.md` covers the transition | `compatibility.json` pointer, `composer api:compat`, `drill.md`, `bash bin/test-compat-baseline-guard.sh`, MigrationGuideTest | P4.3, P4.5, P4.8 |

I19 (archives in clean apps + module relocation rehearsal) supports conditions 1 and 9 (P4.4). After P4.8 every entry of `tests/Arch/invariants.json` has `status: exists` and `blocking: now`.

sections.title: Compatibility comparator (D26): inputs, baseline resolution, rules, guard
sections.text:
Comparator of I18 (D26): our own tool over the attribute manifests and the format fixtures, no new dependency.

### Inputs: `compatibility.json` (repository root)

```json
{
  "schema": "urn:azguard:compatibility:1",
  "candidate": "<40-hex sha or null>",
  "artifacts": [
    {"id": "api.core", "path": "packages/core/api-manifest.json", "kind": "api"},
    {"id": "api.filament", "path": "packages/filament/api-manifest.json", "kind": "api"},
    {"id": "exceptions", "path": "tests/Fixtures/Formats/exceptions.json", "kind": "format"},
    {"id": "events", "path": "tests/Fixtures/Formats/events.json", "kind": "format"},
    {"id": "audit-rows", "path": "tests/Fixtures/Formats/audit-rows.json", "kind": "format"},
    {"id": "audit-journaled-types", "path": "tests/Fixtures/Formats/audit-journaled-types.json", "kind": "format"},
    {"id": "resources", "path": "tests/Fixtures/Formats/resources.json", "kind": "format"},
    {"id": "reserved-plugin-prefix", "path": "tests/Fixtures/Formats/reserved-plugin-prefix.json", "kind": "format"},
    {"id": "config-defaults", "path": "tests/Fixtures/Formats/config-defaults.json", "kind": "format"},
    {"id": "commands", "path": "tests/Fixtures/Console/commands.json", "kind": "format"},
    {"id": "doctor-checks", "path": "tests/Fixtures/Formats/doctor-checks.json", "kind": "format"},
    {"id": "doctor", "path": "tests/Fixtures/Formats/doctor.json", "kind": "format"},
    {"id": "explain", "path": "tests/Fixtures/Formats/explain.json", "kind": "format"},
    {"id": "serializable-types", "path": "tests/Fixtures/Formats/serializable-types.json", "kind": "format"},
    {"id": "ddl.<driver>", "path": "tests/Fixtures/Storage/ddl/<driver>.json", "kind": "format"},
    {"id": "ddl.<driver>.audit", "path": "tests/Fixtures/Storage/ddl/<driver>.audit.json", "kind": "format"}
  ]
}
```

`ddl.*` rows are listed explicitly for sqlite, pgsql, mysql, mariadb (8 rows). Artifacts are matched by `id`; the baseline's own `compatibility.json` gives the baseline path, so a later move of a fixture file is not a break. An id present in the baseline and absent now is the break `artifact.removed`.

### CLI

`php bin/api-compat.php [--against=<ref>|auto] [--json]`; composer script `api:compat` = `php bin/api-compat.php --against=auto`.

- `auto`: the newest tag matching `^v[1-9][0-9]*\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$` (no pre-release, major ≥ 1, so `v0.3.0`/`v0.7.0` never qualify) among `git tag --merged HEAD`, ordered by version; if none, the `candidate` sha of HEAD's `compatibility.json`; if that is null, exit 2 `no compatibility baseline`.
- Baseline files are read with `git show <ref>:<path>`; the comparator parses JSON only and never loads baseline PHP code.
- Exit 0 compatible (additions listed under `additions`), 1 breaks (one line each: `<rule-id> <artifact-id> <locator>: <baseline> -> <current>`), 2 usage or baseline error. `--json` prints `{baseline: {ref, sha}, breaks: [...], additions: [...]}`.
- `composer api:check` (freshness) stays a separate step and runs first: a stale manifest would hide a break.

### PHP rules (artifacts `api.*`; publication values `api`, `spi-implement`, `spi-call`)

| Rule id | Break when |
|:--|:--|
| `type.removed` | a baseline type is missing or lost its publication attribute (moving it under `\Internal\` counts as removal) |
| `type.publication_changed` | publication changed (`api` ↔ `spi-implement` ↔ `spi-call`) or `since` of an existing type changed |
| `type.shape_changed` | kind changed (class/interface/enum/trait), `final` or `readonly` added, `abstract` added, parent removed/changed, an interface removed from `interfaces` |
| `member.removed` | a public method/property/constant/enum case is gone, or a protected one of a non-final type |
| `member.visibility_narrowed` | public → protected, or a member became static/non-static |
| `member.return_changed` | return type text changed |
| `parameter.removed` / `parameter.reordered` | a parameter disappeared or positions changed |
| `parameter.added_required` | a required parameter was added to any supported method |
| `parameter.added_overridable` | any parameter was added to a method that implementers override: every method of an `spi-implement` type and every public/protected non-final method of a non-final type |
| `parameter.renamed` | a parameter name changed where `namedArguments` is true, except methods of `spi-implement` interfaces (core calls them positionally, I20) |
| `parameter.type_changed` | the declared type text changed |
| `parameter.default_changed` | a default was removed or its value changed; `byRef`/`variadic` changed |
| `named.stance_changed` | `namedArguments` true → false on a type or method |
| `implement.method_added` | a method was added to an `spi-implement` interface, or an abstract method to a non-final class |
| `enum.case_removed` / `enum.value_changed` | a case removed or its backing value changed |
| `enum.closed_case_added` | a case was added to an `enum: closed` |
| `enum.closed_reopened` | `closed` → `open` (an open → closed change is allowed) |
| `constant.value_changed` | a public constant value changed |
| `contracts.changed` | the PHPDoc `contracts` (generics, class-strings) of a supported type or member changed |
| `facade.removed` / `facade.changed` | a facade method removed or its signature changed (core manifest `facade`) |
| `roots.changed` | a PSR-4 prefix of `roots` removed or mapped to another prefix (relocation keeps prefixes) |

Allowed and reported as additions: a new supported type; a new method on a `final` class, on an `api` or `spi-call` interface; a new optional trailing parameter of a method nobody overrides (final class or final method, not `spi-implement`); a new constant; a new case of an `enum: open`; `namedArguments` false → true; `open` → `closed`.

### Format rules (artifacts of kind `format`)

Generic semantics: every baseline entry must exist in the current artifact with an equal value; entries may be added. Rule ids are `format.removed` (entry gone) and `format.changed` (value differs), reported with a JSON-pointer-like locator (`events/role.granted/data/role`). Lists of scalars compare as sets; lists of objects match by the key column below. Per artifact:

| Artifact | Entry identity | Frozen values | Allowed additions |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| exceptions | short class name | `class`, `parent`, `abstract`, `final`, every code | new exception, new code-less parent |
| events | `types[].type` string; `events.<type>` | `case`, `class`, envelope/data/tenant/actor/`state` key lists (a renamed or removed key is a break) | new type (EventType is open), new data key |
| audit-rows, audit-journaled-types | event type | column names, payload keys, journaled set | new type, new payload key |
| resources, reserved-plugin-prefix | each named identity (publish tag + its paths, migration basenames, generated-migration patterns, stub path, aliases, namespaces, plugin ids, system actor type, `storage_state` schema) | value | new tag, new migration basename |
| config-defaults | dotted key path; `environment` names; `retired` keys | default value and JSON type; a retired key stays retired | new key with a default |
| commands | command name; synopsis parsed into arguments (name, required, array) and options (name, shortcut, value mode); exit-code labels | argument/option set and modes; exit code per label | new command, new optional option, new exit-code label |
| doctor-checks | check `key` (the internal check FQCN used as JSON key is **not** an identity; match by `key`) | finding ids, `failed_check_id` pattern, severities | new check, new finding id |
| doctor, explain | JSON field names, severities, step names, exit codes | presence and values | new field |
| serializable-types | FQCN | presence | new type |
| ddl.* | table, column, index, constraint names | column type, nullability, default, length, collation; index columns, order, uniqueness; constraint definition | a new table/column/index only together with a new migration basename in `resources` of the same comparison, else `format.ddl_unmigrated` |

### Baseline pointer and guard

- Before the first stable tag the baseline is `candidate`. P4.3 sets it provisionally to the commit P4.3 starts from (`git rev-parse HEAD` before its first commit; a commit cannot name itself); P4.8 replaces it with the frozen candidate C in a commit that changes only `compatibility.json` (and plan files).
- `bin/compat-baseline-guard.sh <base-ref> <head-ref> <labels-json>`: on pull requests, if `git diff --name-only <base>...<head>` contains `compatibility.json`, exit 1 unless the label list contains `compat-baseline` (the explicit release decision). Exit 0 otherwise, 2 on usage errors. `bin/test-compat-baseline-guard.sh` runs isolated fixtures (no change, change with label, change without label, malformed labels) like `bin/test-release-preflight.sh`.
- After a stable tag `vX.Y.Z` (X ≥ 1) is an ancestor, `auto` compares with that tag and the pointer is no longer read; a PR cannot change a tag.
- Not built in P4 (future release decision): an escape hatch for a planned major version.

sections.title: Intentional-break catalogue and drill
sections.text:
Intentional-break proof of phase V1 (one example per frozen category of knowledge/identities and knowledge/contracts).

### Unit catalogue — `tests/Arch/CompatibilityTest.php`

The test loads the current manifests and fixtures as the baseline, applies one in-memory mutation per case to a copy, runs the comparator's comparison function (load `bin/api-compat.php` the way `ApiManifestTest` uses `bin/api-manifest.php`: functions guarded so `require` does not execute the CLI) and asserts the exact rule id. One case per PHP rule id of `#compatibility` (pick real entries: an `spi-implement` interface, a method of `AzGuard\AzGuard`, an `enum: closed` such as `AzGuard\Tenancy\TenantMode`, a final `api` class, an `spi-call` type), one per format artifact (exceptions code, event payload key, journal row column, publish tag, migration basename, config default and environment name, retired key, command option and exit code, doctor finding id matched by `key`, explain key, serializable FQCN, DDL column type, unmigrated DDL addition), plus controls that must stay compatible: new method on a final `api` class, new case of an `enum: open` (`AzGuard\Kernel\…` `DecisionReason` or `EventType`), new optional option, new config key with default, new event type, renamed internal doctor-check FQCN with the same `key`, a moved fixture path with the same artifact id, an identical baseline (exit 0, no additions). Also: `auto` ignores `v0.*` and pre-release tags (unit-test the tag selection function with a list of tag names).

### Drill — `bin/compat-drill.sh [--baseline=<ref>]` (default `HEAD`)

1. `git clone --quiet --no-local <repo> <tmp>`; `cp -al <repo>/vendor <tmp>/vendor` (path-repository symlinks in `vendor/axiomasoft` must be relative so they resolve to the clone's `packages/`; assert it with `readlink`); checkout `<baseline>`; `git tag v1.0.0` **in the clone only**.
2. For each break: apply the patch to real source in the clone, regenerate (`php bin/api-manifest.php --write`; for format breaks the writer-mode fixture run of `p4-execution#conventions` item 5), commit, run `php bin/api-compat.php --against=auto` and require exit 1 with the expected rule id in the output; then `git reset --hard v1.0.0`.
3. Required breaks: (D1) a method added to an `spi-implement` interface (e.g. `AzGuard\Contracts\Plugins\Plugin`) → `implement.method_added`; (D2) a parameter of a public `AzGuard\AzGuard` method renamed → `parameter.renamed`; (D3) a case added to a closed enum (e.g. `AzGuard\Tenancy\TenantMode`) → `enum.closed_case_added`; (D4) an event payload key renamed in the event's `toArray()` → `format.changed` or `format.removed` on `events`; (D5) the core migration file renamed (`packages/core/database/migrations/2026_10_01_000000_create_azguard_storage.php` → another basename) → `format.removed` on `resources`. Control (D6): a public method added to a final `api` class → exit 0. Verify each target's publication/enum class in the manifest before patching; if a named example does not fit, pick another of the same category and say so in `drill.md`.
4. The script asserts that the main repository's `git tag --list` is unchanged at the end, removes the clone, prints one line per drill case and exits 0 only when every case behaved as expected. Evidence: `plans/2026.10.10-№1-AZGUARD-CORE-STABILIZATION/artifacts/evidence/P4/drill.md` (baseline sha, case, rule id, exit).

sections.title: Release gating invariant model (conditions 9 and 10)
sections.text:
Shared invariant model of release gating (conditions 9 and 10).

**Invariant.** A GitHub release and the package split happen only for a tag whose commit passed, in the same workflow run, every qualification workflow and the compatibility comparison against its baseline (for `v1.0.0`: the candidate pointer; afterwards the previous stable tag).

**Enforcement.**

- `tests.yml`, `static-analysis.yml`, `code-style.yml`, `docs.yml` and `tests-nightly.yml` gain a `workflow_call:` trigger (no inputs needed). In `docs.yml` the `deploy` job runs only for `push` to `main` (`if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'`), so a call runs `lint` and `build` only.
- New `compatibility.yml`: triggers `push` (same branches as `tests.yml`), `pull_request` (main), `workflow_call`; checkout with `fetch-depth: 0` and `fetch-tags: true`; PHP 8.4; `composer install`; steps `composer api:check`, `composer api:compat`; on `pull_request` the guard `bash bin/compat-baseline-guard.sh "origin/${GITHUB_BASE_REF}" HEAD "$LABELS"` with `LABELS: ${{ toJSON(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name) }}` passed through `env:` (never interpolated into `run:`, zizmor template-injection rule).
- `release.yml`: jobs `tests`, `static`, `style`, `docs`, `nightly`, `compat` are `uses: ./.github/workflows/<file>.yml`; `validate` keeps manifest validation, the self.version check, the CHANGELOG/preflight steps and the consumer archives and adds `bash bin/consumer-fixture.sh relocated-audit --laravel=13 --version="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"`; the steps of `validate` that duplicate called workflows (analyse, lint, tests, extended) are removed. `split.needs` = `[validate, tests, static, style, docs, nightly, compat]`; `release.needs` = `[split]` plus all of them (explicit list). Permissions stay least-privilege per job (`contents: read` for called jobs; `contents: write` only on `release`).
- `tests.yml` consumer job runs the relocation rehearsal as a fourth step.
- No `continue-on-error` on any job or step of these workflows except the Codecov upload step of `tests.yml` (an upload, not a check), which the test names explicitly.

**Bypass closed.** `split.yml` stays `workflow_call` only; `release.yml` keeps only the tag trigger (no `workflow_dispatch`); the pre-release tag pattern `v*-*` runs the same graph.

**Interfering pairs.** Called workflows inherit the caller's `github.ref` (the tag): `tests.yml` cancels in progress for refs other than main, so two pushes of the same tag cancel the earlier run, which then fails (safe, never green). `tests-nightly.yml` uses `cancel-in-progress: false`. A called workflow's own `on.push.paths` filters do not apply to `workflow_call`.

**Test.** `tests/Arch/ReleaseWorkflowTest.php` parses the YAML with `Symfony\Component\Yaml\Yaml` (present through orchestra/testbench; check how `on:` is parsed — YAML 1.1 readers turn it into `true`) and asserts: every called file has `workflow_call`; release jobs and their `uses`; the `needs` sets of `split` and `release`; `validate` contains the four consumer steps; `compatibility.yml` fetches tags and full history and runs `api:check` before `api:compat`; no `continue-on-error` except the named Codecov step; the label reaches the guard through `env`. Each assertion has a negative case on a mutated array (a removed `needs` entry fails).

sections.title: Module relocation rehearsal (I19)
sections.text:
I19 module relocation rehearsal (D6, knowledge/architecture#transition-policy): a later extraction keeps FQCNs, commands, config sections, publish tags, event types, migration basenames and populated data, with one autoload owner. The rehearsal moves **Audit** (table, migration basename, publish tag, two commands, plugin id, doctor check, journal rows) — the most demanding slice.

`bash bin/consumer-fixture.sh relocated-audit [--laravel=13] [--version=1.0.0] [--keep]` (same exit codes as the other modes: 0, 1, 3 = Packagist unreachable, never green):

1. **Before.** Build the full core archive as the default mode does; create the clean Laravel app with an audited panel (`AuditPlugin` on the fixture panel, reuse `fixtures/consumer`); `vendor:publish --tag=azguard-audit-migrations`; `migrate`; two audited grant changes. Record: `migrate:status` basenames, `audit_log` row count, `event_id`s and a hash of each `payload`, `azguard:doctor --json` exit and findings, `php artisan list --format=json` entries of `azguard:audit:*`.
2. **Relocate.** Build (in `build/`) a core archive without `modules/audit` (composer.json loses the `AzGuard\Audit\` PSR-4 root and `AzGuard\Audit\AuditServiceProvider`, as `core-only` does for every module) and a synthetic archive `axiomasoft/azguard-audit` whose root is the content of `packages/core/modules/audit` with a composer.json: `name`, `type: library`, `require: {"axiomasoft/azguard": "<version>"}`, `autoload.psr-4: {"AzGuard\\Audit\\": "src/"}`, `extra.laravel.providers: ["AzGuard\\Audit\\AuditServiceProvider"]`, the stamped version, LICENSE. Require both from the artifact repository and `composer update` in the same app.
3. **After — assert:** `composer dump-autoload -o` then `AzGuard\Audit\AuditPlugin` resolves to a file under `vendor/axiomasoft/azguard-audit/` and the installed core composer.json has no `AzGuard\Audit\` root (one owner); `migrate:status` shows `2026_10_20_000000_create_azguard_audit_log` as ran and `migrate --pretend` has nothing to run; `vendor:publish --tag=azguard-audit-migrations` publishes no new file; `azguard:audit:prune` and `azguard:audit:migration` exist with the synopsis of `tests/Fixtures/Console/commands.json`; `azguard:doctor --json` exits 0 with `audit.table` passing; the journal rows are unchanged (count, event ids, payload hashes); one more audited change appends exactly one row; `azguard:audit:prune --force` exits 0.
4. Evidence `plans/2026.10.10-№1-AZGUARD-CORE-STABILIZATION/artifacts/evidence/P4/relocation.md`: archives and their sha256, before/after tables, exit codes.

Nothing of this lands in the repository as a package: no `packages/audit`, no split configuration, no Packagist step.

sections.title: Race, consistency and load evidence (I21, I22)
sections.text:
Race, consistency and load evidence (condition 7; I11, I12, I21, I22 amended by D24).

**Race and consistency (acceptance in P4.6):** `composer test:db -- pgsql --engines`, `… mysql --engines`, `… mariadb --engines`; `composer test:replica` (docker profile `authority-replica`); `composer test:redis` (Redis from `docker-compose.yml`); `composer test:extended`; `composer test:db -- <driver> --parallel --full` for pgsql, mysql, mariadb (the nightly depth, RELEASING.md step 1). `race.md`: one row per run (sha, command, exit, tests/assertions, duration, log).

**Load (I22):** PHP 8.4 with `pcntl`, `posix`, `redis` (present on this host). For each pair sqlite/none, sqlite/array, pgsql/none, pgsql/redis, mysql/none, mariadb/none:

```bash
php -d memory_limit=2G -d opcache.enable_cli=1 -d opcache.jit_buffer_size=0 bench/bin/run.php \
    --tier=mini --driver=<driver> --cache=<cache> --out=bench/results/<YYYY-MM-DD>-1.0-<driver>-<cache>-mini
```

(read `bench/bin/run.php --help` first for the exact `--out` and `--profile` semantics). A run qualifies when it exits 0, every correctness check of `bench/profiles.json` passes, every `*_error` count is 0 and each stage is marked `stable`; an unstable stage is re-run once and both results are recorded. `check_inconsistent` under writes is the designed outcome and is reported, not failed. A correctness failure or engine error is a demonstrated defect (convention 1).

**Reference.** The new files are the 1.0 reference; the 0.x-era files `bench/results/2026-10-09-*` are deleted (D24) and the "Published results" section of `bench/README.md` is rewritten from the new files (date, host CPU, PHP, database and Redis versions, same table columns). RELEASING.md step 1 gains: before a release, run the same pairs on the same host and `php bench/bin/compare.php <reference>.json <new>.json`; a reported regression needs a fix or a sentence in the release notes. `load.md` summarizes the runs.

**Code freeze dependency.** P4.8 runs `git diff --quiet <last P4.6 commit> <candidate> -- packages/core/src packages/core/modules packages/filament/src`; if production code changed after P4.6, the affected profiles are re-run on the candidate.

sections.title: Validation commands, environment and CI evidence
sections.text:
Run from the repository root with PHP 8.4: `mkdir -p <scratch>/php84 && ln -sf /usr/bin/php8.4 <scratch>/php84/php` and prefix every command with `PATH=<scratch>/php84:$PATH` (composer is `/usr/local/bin/composer`). Database services (Docker context `default`; `docker context use default` if `docker ps` reports a socket error): PostgreSQL 25432, MySQL 23306, MariaDB 23307 — export `PGSQL_PORT=25432 MYSQL_PORT=23306 MARIADB_PORT=23307` before driver commands (check `docker ps`; Redis and the replica profile come from `docker-compose.yml`).

| Purpose | Command |
|:--|:--|
| Architecture checks | `php -d memory_limit=1G vendor/bin/pest tests/Arch --fail-on-skipped` |
| Parity, I7, inactive cost, formats | `php -d memory_limit=1G vendor/bin/pest tests/Feature/Parity tests/Feature/InactiveCost tests/Regression --fail-on-skipped` |
| Full SQLite suite | `composer test` |
| PHP 8.3 suite | `/usr/bin/php8.3 -d memory_limit=1G vendor/bin/pest --fail-on-skipped --exclude-group=engines --exclude-group=redis --exclude-group=replica --exclude-group=extended` (if the installed vendor needs PHP ≥ 8.4, record that and rely on the CI 8.3 jobs) |
| Database lanes | `composer test:db -- pgsql --parallel`, `… mysql --parallel`, `… mariadb --parallel` (`--full` = nightly depth) |
| Engines | `composer test:db -- pgsql --engines`, `… mysql --engines`, `… mariadb --engines` |
| Replica / Redis / extended | `composer test:replica`, `composer test:redis`, `composer test:extended` |
| Static analysis, style, refactor, manifests | `composer analyse && composer lint:check && composer refactor:check && composer api:check` (bare `pint --test` also sees the git-excluded `var/perf/prepend.php`; `composer lint:check` is the gate) |
| Type coverage, coverage | `composer test:types`, `composer check:coverage` |
| Compatibility (P4.3+) | `composer api:compat`, `bash bin/compat-drill.sh [--baseline=<ref>]`, `bash bin/test-compat-baseline-guard.sh` |
| Consumer archives | `bash bin/consumer-fixture.sh`, `… --with-filament`, `… core-only`, `… relocated-audit` (P4.4) |
| Docs | `composer docs:language && composer docs:php`; build `npm ci && npm run docs:build` (ask the owner if Node is not available to the agent; CI Docs job is the fallback evidence) |
| Release notes | `bash bin/release-preflight.sh 1.0.0 HEAD`, `bash bin/test-release-preflight.sh`, `bash bin/release-notes.sh 1.0.0 HEAD` |

**Composer after editing a package `composer.json`** (P4.1 aliases): the root installs the packages through a path repository; the change reaches `vendor/` only after `composer update axiomasoft/azguard axiomasoft/azguard-filament --no-interaction`. If the agent may not run it, ask the owner (`! composer update axiomasoft/azguard axiomasoft/azguard-filament`). `composer.lock` is gitignored.

**GitHub Actions evidence** (owner gate `CI-PUSH`): `git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/feat/1.0-candidate` (use `--force-with-lease` only on that branch); `gh workflow run tests-nightly.yml --ref feat/1.0-candidate`; wait with `gh run watch <id>` or poll `gh run list --branch feat/1.0-candidate`; then

```bash
SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD); OUT=plans/2026.10.10-№1-AZGUARD-CORE-STABILIZATION/artifacts/evidence/P4/ci-runs-$SHA.json
gh run list --commit "$SHA" --limit 100 --json databaseId,workflowName,event,headSha,status,conclusion,url > "$OUT"
python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); need=set(sys.argv[2].split(",")); ok={x["workflowName"] for x in r if x["conclusion"]=="success"}; bad=[x for x in r if x["workflowName"] in need and x["conclusion"]!="success"]; sys.exit(0 if need<=ok and not bad else 1)' "$OUT" "Tests,Static Analysis,Code Style,Zizmor,CodeQL,Tests (nightly)"
```

From P4.5 on add `Compatibility` to the required list (the workflow `name:` of `compatibility.yml`). A failed job is read with `gh run view --job <id> --log-failed` or `gh api repos/axiomasoft/azguard-private/actions/jobs/<id>/logs`.
